description: First M1 voice-asset definition. Scope is dev/dogfooding only — see hey-chef-wakeword.publish_eligible=false. The first public-release-eligible build is v2, after the custom-trained Hey Chef classifier replaces the openwakeword.com community model.

assets.upstream_url: openwakeword.com/library community section — manual download; specific URL not recorded at download time
assets.sha256: TBD — populated by scripts/hash.sh after mirroring
assets.notes: DEV/DOGFOOD ONLY. Per openwakeword.com/terms (reviewed 2026-05-19) the community models cannot be redistributed in a public release. This entry stays in staging/v1/ for the developer's local builds only; scripts/publish.sh skips assets with publish_eligible=false. Custom-trained replacement lands in v2 before TestFlight.

assets.upstream_url: https://huggingface.co/FluidInference/kokoro-82m-coreml (English subset; see upstream/kokoro.md for the file list)
assets.notes: Pending architecture decision in M1_PLAN.md (Option A tarball / B HF-direct via FluidAudio's ModelRegistry.baseURL override / C skip from v1). Option A's filename + format shown here as the default; revise once decided.

removed_assets.reason: Whisper dropped from M1 scope. ~1.6 GB asset + ~1.5–2 GB peak resident RAM not justified vs. iOS 26 SpeechAnalyzer / SFSpeechRecognizer (both OS-shipped). Reintroduced only via the conditional post-MVP 'Whisper open-form-STT quality experiment' milestone in SousChefApp-v2 docs/milestone-plan.md — if that ever runs, it ships its own asset version (not v1).
